IS: 10573-1983 

3. Material — The material for different components of the oil sight glass shall be as follows : 

Body — Aluminium conforming to IS : 617-1975 'Aluminium and aluminium alloy ingots and 
castings for general engineering purposes ( second revision ) '. 

Glass Pane — Transparent sheet glass conforming to IS : 2835-1977 'Flat transparent sheet 
glass ( second revision )'. 

Packing — Oil resistant rubber. 

Reflector — Oil resistant white plastic. 

4. Designation — An oil sight glass of size d — M36 x 1*5 shall be designated as : 

Oilsight Glass M36 x 15 IS : 10573 

5. Leakage Test — The oil sight glass when tested with any hydraulic/lubricating oil of grades 
ISO vG68 to ISO vG220 in accordance with IS: 9466-1980 'Viscosity classification for industrial 
liquid lubricants ', shall withstand a temperature up to 80°C and shall not leak at a pressure of 
0*3 MPa. 

5.1 The actual method of test is left to the manufacturer. 

6. Marking — Shall be marked at an appropriate place with the size d and the manufacturer's name 
or trade-mark. 

6.1 IS/ Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Standardization of the 'oilsight glass for machine tools' was felt for a long time. The committee 
entrusted with standardization of this product, formulated this standard based upon experience and 
information available about various types and sizes of oil-sight glasses manufactured and used in this 
country by the industries. 



Printed at Printrade. New Delhi, India
